record_scope_reconstruction: Three separate Mong Cai–Dongxing customs channels: Bac Luan I, Bac Luan II and Km3+4 pontoon. All three are named by the Vietnamese ministry report. Customs clearance is goods/trucks in both directions, not general passenger restoration.

source_checks.finding: Ministry report names all three channels and dates customs restart, prioritising stranded farm/frozen goods.
Provincial government locates 114 m Km3+4 pontoon in Hai Yen and identifies management/operator responsibilities.
